description: Turn-by-turn cost of a Gemini 4 agent run: every turn re-sends the growing context as input, thinking tokens are billed at the output rate. Returns the rates in force on the chosen date, the simulated total, the naive first-turn × turns estimate and their multiplier. Before the 2026-12-01 price change it also returns afterIncrease: the same run priced at the announced 2026-12-01 rates.

contextGrowthPerTurn.description: Net history added after each completed turn; billed from turn 2 onward.

date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) that selects the price segment in force that day. Defaults to today (UTC).

initialContextTokens.description: System prompt, tool definitions and documents sent on turn 1.

outputTokensPerTurn.description: Visible answer tokens per turn, excluding thinking.

thinkingLevel.description: Thinking budget. Thinking tokens are billed at the output price: off = 0×, low ≈0.5×, medium ≈1.5×, high ≈3× the visible output tokens.

turns.description: Number of turns (separate API calls) in the run.

userToolInputTokensPerTurn.description: New user/tool content billed on top of the context each turn.

name: estimate_agent_run
title: Estimate the cost of one Gemini 4 agent run
